invariant_input_check.exact_HF_paragraph: The prescribed scalar time-ordered contraction input is a symmetric distribution $H_F\in\mathcal D'(\mathbb M^2)$ invariant under translations and $SO^+(1,3)$, equal to $W(x,y)$ on the open set $x^0>y^0$ and to $W(y,x)$ on $y^0>x^0$. The two prescriptions agree on spacelike-separated open supports because $E$ is supported on causal pairs. Translation invariance gives $H_F(x,y)=h_F(x-y)$ and $W(x,y)=w(x-y)$. For a distribution $T$ on $\mathbb R^4$, set $T_\rho(\varphi)=\rho^{-4}T(\varphi(\cdot/\rho))$ and define $\operatorname{sd}_0(T)$ as the infimum of real $\omega$ for which $\rho^\omega T_\rho\to0$ on each fixed test as $\rho\downarrow0$.
